build_hrfpn_backbone: build an HRFPN backbone from a Detectron2 config with HRNet and ROI head settings
create_HRFPN_instance: create an HRFPN module with a bottom-up HRNet backbone, input features, and output channels
run_HRFPN_forward: run the HRFPN forward pass to transform HRNet outputs into feature pyramid outputs
review_HRFPN_init_weights: review the HRFPN init_weights method that applies Kaiming normal initialization to conv layers
refactor_HRFPN_pooling: refactor the HRFPN class to switch between MAX and AVG pooling strategies for feature pyramids
